parts.text: I plan and run flights for my company, handling jobs that include deliveries carrying loads between sites and inspections taking drones with the right sensors to a list of points in a set order before bringing them back. Several of us plan at the same time for the same busy sites and popular drones, and I use airspace information from the authorities that is the same for everyone. It is my legal responsibility to choose which drone flies and along which way, and I sign off each flight before it leaves and can call it off if needed.
